scope: 30 distinct Test capture sessions; 1 Docker lab/Suricata source provenance, 4 scenarios
study_design_limitations: A Test capture session is an incident candidate until evidence/incident eligibility is adjudicated.
Only one source provenance: this does not demonstrate multi-provenance stratification.
The selective rule was pilot-informed on the same 30-session cohort; this is not independent held-out confirmation.
The runner preserves an EXPLORATORY_LAB_ONLY_NOT_MAIN label; copying its output does not change that status.
The LLM runner uses temperature=0.2; its seed controls local order only and is not passed as a seed to Ollama.
No analyst utility, correctness or security impact can be inferred from schema validity.
selective_rule: Observed Suricata alert_count >= 50; 14 cases invoke LLM in each repetition
note: This audit does NOT assert rubric agreement, independent reviewer approval, multi-provenance coverage, or E5 completion.
